# An Agent Tool Layer and Derived Documentation for the Book's Examples {#sec-appI}

*Appendix intent: the runnable, versioned counterpart to the concepts of the generative-AI chapter. Four parts: the `tools/dvh` substrate (design, testbench and evidence models; CLI, JSON and tool-protocol doors); the tool set with role permissions and schemas; the derived-document types and the extract, narrate, verify, publish workflow, kit-neutral with one named example; and the knowledge-base retrieval design with its evaluation set. Every listing is a file under `tools/dvh/` or `examples/`, verified in CI. The narration step waits on the recorded-transcript decision; everything else is deterministic.*
